signIn.heading: Sign in to Karma
signIn.subhead: No password to remember. We'll email you a one-time code.

codeStep.label: Verification code
codeStep.hint: Didn't get a code? Check your spam folder, or click the link in the email instead — it signs you in too.

errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed you.
errors.codeInvalid: That code is incorrect or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

callback.heading: Signing you in…
callback.errorBody: The link may have expired or already been used. Request a new sign-in code and try again.

account.heading: Hi, {{name}}
account.staleNotice: You're offline, so this is the last information we saved on this device.

profile.heading: Your profile
profile.saveError: Something went wrong saving your profile. Please try again.
profile.saveErrorOffline: You're offline. Reconnect and try saving again.

waiver.heading: Liability waiver
waiver.current: You're on the current waiver, version {{version}}.
waiver.outdated: There's a newer waiver, version {{version}}. Please review and accept it to keep participating in events.
waiver.acceptError: Something went wrong accepting the waiver. Please try again.
